onboarding.slide1Title: Snap a receipt. Get a record.
onboarding.slide1Body: Take a photo of any service receipt — from your mechanic or the parts store. Glovebox turns it into a clean record you approve.
onboarding.slide2Body: Set reminders by miles or months. Glovebox tells you before your next oil change, rotation or inspection is due.
onboarding.slide3Body: Share a clean service history with buyers — the maintenance CARFAX never sees.

auth.title: Welcome to Glovebox
auth.subtitle: Your car’s paperwork, finally in one place.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.invalidCode: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.
auth.legalPrefix: By continuing you agree to the

garage.title: Garage
garage.emptyBody: Start with the VIN or pick the year, make and model.

vehicle.vinHint: Enter a 17-character VIN to decode year, make and model automatically.
vehicle.nicknameHint: e.g. Daily driver or Weekend car
vehicle.electricNotice: Some reminders may not apply to electric cars — review them
vehicle.archiveBody: Archived vehicles are hidden from the garage but keep all their records.
vehicle.deleteBody: This will permanently delete the vehicle and all its records, photos and reminders. This cannot be undone.
vehicle.saveError: Could not save vehicle. Please try again.

suggest.title: The VIN shows different details. Apply?

record.saveError: Could not save record. Please try again.
record.deleteBody: This will permanently delete this record. This cannot be undone.
record.saveInvalid: This record couldn't be saved because some amounts don't add up. Check the line items and totals, then try again.
record.saveForbidden: You don't have permission to change this record.
record.checkFields_one: Check 1 field the AI wasn’t sure about.
record.checkFields_other: Check {{count}} fields the AI wasn’t sure about.
record.mismatch: The receipt total is {{receipt}}, but the items and tax add up to {{computed}}. Check the line items and tax.
record.duplicateBody: You already have a record on this date with the same total and shop.
record.aiDraftNote: Draft from your receipt. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.
record.noAmountBody: Add line items or enter the total.
record.taxExceedsTitle: Tax is more than the total
record.taxExceedsBody: Check the tax and the total.
record.totalHint: No line items? Enter the total from the receipt.

odometer.rollbackWarning: This reading is lower than a previous one. It will be excluded from mileage projections unless you override it.
odometer.jumpWarning: This reading seems unusually high. Please double-check.
odometer.saveError: Could not save reading. Please try again.

sync.error: Some changes didn't sync. Will retry.
sync.dead_one: {{count}} change couldn't sync — tap to review
sync.dead_other: {{count}} changes couldn't sync — tap to review
sync.reviewHint: These changes were tried 5 times and didn't go through. Retry, or discard them.
sync.discardBody: {{change}} will be removed from this phone and won't be saved. This can't be undone.

settings.leadTime: Remind me before a service is due
settings.exportHint: A ZIP with your records (JSON and CSV) and receipt photos.
settings.exportTooLargeBody: Photos make it too large to download at once. Export your records without photos instead?
settings.exportFailed: Your export couldn't be prepared. Check your connection and try again.
settings.subscriptionBody: Deleting your account doesn't cancel your subscription. Cancel it first in Settings → your name → Subscriptions, or Apple will keep billing you.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your cars, service records, receipt photos and share links. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteTypeBody: Your account and all of its data will be deleted right away.
settings.deleteTypeMismatch: That didn’t match. Your account was not deleted.
settings.deleteFailed: Your account couldn't be deleted. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was removed.
settings.deletedBody: Your account and data have been deleted.

scan.title: Scan receipt
scan.hint: Glovebox reads the receipt and fills in a draft. Nothing is saved until you check it and tap Save.
scan.scannerUnavailable: The camera scanner isn’t available on this device. Choose a photo or PDF instead.
scan.processingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
scan.tooLarge: That file is too large (10 MB max).
scan.duplicateImageBody: You already saved a record with this receipt image.

error.quota_exceeded: You’ve used this month’s receipt scans. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.not_a_receipt: This doesn’t look like a receipt. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.unreadable: We couldn’t read this receipt. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.ai_disabled: Receipt reading is turned off right now. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.provider_error: Receipt reading isn’t available right now. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.timeout: Reading the receipt took too long. The photo is attached — enter the details below.
error.file_too_large: That file is too large to read (10 MB max). Enter the details below.
error.unsupported_type: That file type can’t be read. Enter the details below.
error.attachment_not_found: The photo couldn’t be found. Enter the details below.

error.network: You’re offline, so the receipt can’t be read. Enter the details below.
